description: Canonical registry of verifiable claims that a Chio kernel can make on behalf of a tenant. Authoritative reference for the trajectory-4 Evidence Gate (see .planning/trajectory-4/SYNTHESIS-V2-INTEGRATED-PLAN.md). Every signed artifact and every behavioral guarantee a verifier can check has a row here.

claims.summary: A CapabilityToken carries a signature from the issuing authority over the canonical body.
A receipt carries the kernel's signed verdict for a single mediated tool call.
A delegated child capability scope is a subset of its parent (no privilege amplification).

Peers exchange a feature bitset and a maximum capability-token schema at handshake time. The verifier rejects inbound tokens whose schema exceeds the negotiated ceiling, blocking a v1-only Mallory from forcing a v2-aware Alice to parse v2-only fields.

trj4_proposed_claims.summary: A v2 CapabilityToken carries an on-the-wire attenuation_proof witness; verifiers check the witness hashes and subset relation fail closed.
A v2 receipt is content-addressed by body_hash := H(canonical_jcs(ReceiptV2BodyHashInput)) where the input set strictly excludes body_hash, signature, and the legacy UUIDv7 receipt_id.
Multi-parent receipt lineage carries a signed dag_ordinal + HLC triple; verifier predicate child.dag_ordinal > max(parent.dag_ordinal) rejects cycles across independent kernel clock domains.

A chio.anchor_batch.v1 publishes a Merkle root over N receipts/checkpoints to a public witness lane (Rekor / OTS / Solana memo). Per-receipt local sign stays unchanged; the batch upgrades continuity and non-repudiation, additive over per-receipt verification.
Capability tokens, federation handshake envelopes, and receipts accept a hybrid:<classical>:<pq>:<alg_set> signature wire format with the algorithm enum value 'hybrid'.
Federation handshakes bind a Bronze, Silver, or Gold conformance tier into the signed challenge, and quorum policy rejects peers below min_tier before admission.
